requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/wordcount.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/wordcount_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func WordCount(s string) map[string]int`. Count how often each word occurs. Words are separated by any whitespace and compared case-insensitively (keys are lower-case). An empty or blank string returns an empty, non-nil map.
acceptance_criteria: func WordCount(s string) map[string]int: Count how often each word occurs. Words are separated by any whitespace and compared case-insensitively (keys are lower-case). An empty or blank string returns an empty, non-nil map.
